changes.evidence: Joy is already Rand Enterprises' chief counsel/co-runner throughout Iron Fist S1 (she runs the company with Ward when Danny returns, ep 1 onward). She only leaves in Iron Fist S2 ep 1 (The Fury of Iron Fist), presenting a divestment package to buy out of Rand Enterprises. The Rand Enterprises stage should start at Iron Fist S1, not S2; the S2 departure (left) stays.

In Jessica Jones S2 ep 9 (AKA Shark in the Bathtub, Monster in the Bed), Trish has an on-air breakdown and quits Trish Talk ('I quit'). She never returns to the show; in S3 she is the vigilante Hellcat with no group. The record still has her in Trish Talk.

Rosalie Carbone is the head of the Carbone crime family in both titles on file (Luke Cage S2, where Luke warns her mob out of Harlem, and Daredevil S3, where she pays Fisk for protection as a crime boss). Her only affiliation is the Carbone Crime Family; the record has no group (compare Ma Gnucci and the Gnucci Crime Family).

owner_calls.question: V1: this record merges two separate characters, Jakob Nystrom and Petra Larsen, who each have their own wiki page. Keep as a pair record or split into two records?
options: Split into Jakob Nystrom and Petra Larsen
owner_calls.evidence: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1 ep 8 (The Well): Jakob Nystrom and Petra Larsen are two Norse pagan extremists; Petra is killed and Jakob captured. They are two people.
